line: K6 = L6c[0:1576] + idle x154 (ride snake 3's 7984-run 10 px behind the head instead of walking up to it: the head never pauses), Left x2 (face the snake), A x8 (hop: grab the vertical body, come down on the head 7 frames after it turns onto the top run), idle x61 (ride), Right x1, idle x1, Right+A x54 (standstill dash jump, 56 frames in the air, into the exit hole's capture zone at (369, 8099), index 1857), idle x223 (129 frames to room 2 + 94 in the warp room), Right x1, idle x1, Right+A x170 (warp room, portal touch at r+266, x 419), idle x180, A, idle x9, B, idle x12, A, idle x11. Indices are segment inputs; the warp room starts at index 1986 (L6c: 2022); r = frames since then.
mechanism: Read the record's video frame by frame (60 fps canvas grabs, logs/fix/u16k_wr_jump.jpg, u16k_wr_z1.jpg, u16k_wr_z2.jpg, u16k_wr_flight.jpg, pixel measurements logs/fix/u16k_wr_meas.json): he stands at the spawn spot, flies at the snake at ~3 px/f, climbs, crosses the head top at ~3 px/f and keeps flying right at ~2.8 px/f. That is RUN speed (192) the whole way.

The missing piece was the STANDSTILL DASH JUMP: tap Right, release one frame, then Right+A on the same frame (jump on the second tap). That jump has air speed 192 at once, and the run state survives the grab as long as Right+A stays held without a break: every time the toad loses contact with the snake it moves at 3 px/f instead of accelerating from 1 px/f. A jump one or more frames after the second tap (out of a ground run) only has 144; one frame of Right without A, or A without Right, while clinging also drops it.

Climbing: holding Right+A against the snake's left side re-grabs every frame (vertical speed reset to 3.0 px/f): 3 px/f against the head's 2 px/f. The old Left+A/Right+A alternation and the hold-A climb are slower.

The toad can only leave the left side when its height passes a 32-px grid (7586, 7618, 7650, ... = body tiles) before the next tile is laid: crossings come in slots 16 frames apart (over the head at r+119..123, 135..140, 152..156, 168..172, 184..190). The crossing itself is 8 frames (x 95 -> 119 at 3 px/f, then the game sets the toad to x 128 on the head's right side with vertical speed 3.0), then free flight at 3 px/f, gravity 39/256 per frame with A held, terminal fall 4 px/f.

Launch height decides everything: the 7605 and 7637..7641 slots fly into the first star (hit at (224, 7619..7624) and (233..236, 7646)); 7667..7672 (over the head at r+168..172) clears it by about 30 px, lands on the ledge at x 359..362 still running and touches the portal 19 frames later. Earlier slots that duck under the star (A released in flight) fall 40 px short of the ledge (290..293, 7497..7519).

Portal: touched at x 416 (the very edge) the warp animation is 5 frames longer than at x >= 417; rj 94 (touch r+266 at x 419) beats rj 93 (touch r+264 at x 416) by 2 frames at the placement. Warp pages: only three presses matter (found by BFS over nothing/A/B per frame); no Start.
tried_and_dead: double tap of Right while already clinging (12 tap patterns from 35 cuts, u16k_tap.py): never run speed
delaying the climb with frames of Right-only or A-only to hit a launch height between the slots (u16k_scan1/2): loses the run speed, lands short or on the star
start position (walk right 4..24 or left 4..16 before the jump, u16k_scan3): crossing slots do not move; touching/standing right of x 104 before the head rises just runs into the spikes
earlier slot + A released in flight to pass under the first star (330 flights, u16k_under.py): none reaches the ledge

standing on the rising head for a full jump (4.7 px/f up) with a dash: the rising head is NOT standable in this room - a toad over its top is always carried in the clinging state (z 8), even with its vertical speed poked to falling on a snapshot (u16k_pokeprobe.py, throwaway probe); beams u16k_beam.py / u16k_beam2.py found no standing state. The one 'standing' seen (u16k_stand.py) is on the snake after its turn at the top, far too late
one-frame releases on the ledge to shift the touch x (u16k_ledge.py): x 417..419 all give the same animation; nothing earlier than touch r+266 with x >= 417

room 1: K6c's later inputs simply shifted 4..8 frames behind the pause-free ride: no capture (the toad faces right after the ride and the hop does not grab the snake; needs the Left x2 tap) (u16k_r1shift.py)
room 1: waiting at the park spot (334, 7934) and jumping straight up onto the 7984-run after the head has turned: the lower run retracts at ~1550 and the toad falls two floors (u16k_r1ride2.py)
room 1: capture 2 frames sooner needs the toad 6 px ahead of the head's coordinate at the jump, the very edge of what the head carries; boardings and walks tried all end on the same capture frame

notes: K6 verified from the bookmark and twice from power-on (RAM sha1 0f56db25): Level 8 placement on frame 12355 instead of 12483 (-128). Warp room (-90): the record's own line, started 16 frames earlier than he does - standstill dash jump at the snake (Right, release, Right+A on one frame keeps run speed 192 through the grab while Right+A stays held), climb at 3 px/f, over the rising head, 3 px/f flight over the first star to the ledge, portal touch at r+266 (up14 r+356; the record ~r+280). Room 1 (-36): ride the third snake behind its head so it never pauses (-6), board its head as it turns onto the top run and dash-jump from it straight into the exit hole's capture zone (-30). Warp pages by BFS, three presses, no Start (-2). Everything behind Level 6 has to be re-fitted. Open lead: ~20 more frames in room 1 by keeping the toad off the snakes' heads (see 'not_done').
room1: HEAD PAUSES (the biggest lead left): a snake's head stops for single frames whenever the toad is in its way - clinging right under it, standing at or ahead of its coordinate, or flying close in front of it. With the toad kept 2+ px behind the coordinate (riding) or well below the head (clinging) it never pauses. L6c has 32 such single-frame pauses in room 1 (logs/fix/u16k_r1pauses_L6c.txt); K6 removes the six on snake 3's 7984-run by simply not walking up to the head (the head turns up at index 1708 instead of 1714).

The room's exit is not a ledge to stand on but a capture zone: a toad that enters x >= ~366 at H ~8096..8130 (checked every 2 frames) freezes, and room 2 loads 129 frames later. L6c ran along the snake and jumped from x 272 (captured ~1893); K6 is captured at 1857.
Snake 3's head carries a standing toad from about 30 px behind its coordinate to about 6 px ahead; further ahead it drops off.

Boarding the top run: from the park spot (126, 7998) the toad must FACE the vertical body (Left x2) or A does not grab it; then a short hop (A x8) clings to the body at x 112 and lands on the head right at its coordinate just after the turn; the old A x32 hop landed 44 frames later with the head 80 px ahead.

Dash jump from the head (tap Right, release, Right+A): 3 px/f, apex +73, A held to the end; it reaches the capture zone from x >= 199..203, i.e. when the head is at x ~196..200. Right, gap, Right on the head is a dash and runs off its front: walk with ONE hold only.
Sweeps of the boarding (idle 22..36 x A 4..20) and of 0..12 walk frames all end on the same capture frame (2-frame grid).
